_note: Mayhem augments the all-champion simulator models: the ones whose effect fits a generic kit. Ids, names, rarities and values are the live patch's client files (kiwi.bin, each augment's spell DataValues and calculations), filled in by tools/build_augments.py. confidence is verified when every value is read from the client and approx when one rests on an assumption the note states. Effect keys are the same as items (README.md).

witchful_thinking.name: Witchful Thinking
witchful_thinking.note: AP kept at the earlier hand value: the client tooltip shows 20-80 AP by level (calculation AP) while the spell's DataValue APFlat is 70; which one the game grants is unclear

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.note: 1.5% Armor and Magic Resist shred per stack for 4 s, up to 20 stacks; 15 stacks assumed as the mid-fight average

tank_engine.name: Tank Engine
tank_engine.note: 5% max Health per takedown, 65% of stacks lost on death; 10 late-game takedowns assumed

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.note: Up to 1% max Health true damage in all; the sim assumes full distance traveled

mystic_punch.name: Mystic Punch
mystic_punch.note: Cooldowns can't be refunded below 50% (MinCDR), not modeled

jeweled_gauntlet.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
jeweled_gauntlet.note: Also grants 0.045% crit chance per AP (CritGranted), not modeled

infernal_conduit.name: Infernal Conduit
infernal_conduit.note: Burn per second is 2-20 by level + 1.2% AP + 2.8% bonus AD for 3 s; the level-based part is not modeled

poro_stampede.name: Poro Stampede
poro_stampede.note: Quest augment: feed Poros to unlock Poro Charge (120 s cooldown; the spell's newer Cooldown field says 105 s), one wave per milestone (5, 12, 20, 30, 44, 63, 90, 129, 187, 275 fed). Damage 100-200 by level + 20 per Poro fed, physical; later waves deal 50% to champions already hit (kiwi.bin PoroCharge_Active). Assumes the quest is done with 20 Poros fed (3 waves). Wave length, width and spacing are estimates from the Poro missile (speed 900, radius 210); the first wave's 85% slow is not modeled.
